engine.releaseNotes: 34 voices; R3 Ghost Protocol and V-Sync v11; YouTube Warp Bus routes the live YouTube feed through all 29 warp modes and 34 voices; v6.3.1 adds the SVG Warp Lens (feTurbulence→feDisplacementMap) for per-pixel YouTube displacement; playback body classes now toggled; v6.4 adds getDisplayMedia Tab Capture — real pixels + real tab audio through the full Canvas engine; v6.4.17 explicitly routes YouTube full-effects use through capture of a separate source tab/window and restores the original Canvas FX path. v6.4.20: original AI Warp modes run on active voice-canvas graphics in-page without capture; capture applies them to actual YouTube frames. v6.4.21 softens Ghost/V-Sync channel and scanline intensity and cycles RGB hues across the full spectrum. v6.4.21 improves Ghost/V-Sync with reduced split/scan heaviness and flowing RGB spectrum coloring. v6.4.22 replaces single-hue Ghost/V-Sync scan lines with softer five-hue spectral ghost echoes and animated RGB-spectrum V-Sync beams. v6.4.23 keeps spectral Ghost/V-Sync line accents at 20% opacity while increasing the surrounding channel split, warp and scanphasing strength. v6.4.24 sets the multicolor Ghost and V-Sync line strokes to 5% opacity while preserving the strengthened surrounding screen-phasing effects. v6.4.25 sets the visible Ghost horizontal sweep stroke to 5% opacity; multicolor Ghost/V-Sync lines remain at 5%, while broader screen-phase effect strengths are unchanged. v6.4.26 removes luminous Ghost sweep and V-Sync scan-head/beam line accents (zero alpha) while preserving surrounding screen phasing and image tears. v6.4.27 limits only the one-shot Ghost/V-Sync mode-change sweeps to 5% opacity; steady-state Ghost/V-Sync processing remains active. v6.4.28 applies 5% opacity only to the initial Ghost/V-Sync mode-change pulse; steady-state RGB Ghost and V-Sync effects retain their stronger 6.4.22 levels. v6.4.29 gives all 29 AI Warp modes explicit deterministic Ghost/V-Sync blend profiles, including per-mode RGB hue phase, split, warp, scan, tear, and roll tuning; rendered scan noise is repeatable. v6.4.30 adds per-warp Hard Light, Soft-Eye, audio-ear, canvas-response, and automation blend tuning for all 29 modes. Crescendo/burst and auto-voice choices use a seeded deterministic sequence; automation rails are mode-aware. v6.4.31 adds DROP THE MILK?, an original Milkdrop/projectM-inspired Canvas FX automation with feedback zoom/rotation, audio-reactive polar waveforms, soft liquid colour blooms, and six timed blend presets; includes toolbar button and D shortcut. v6.4.32 expands DROP THE MILK? to 80 uniquely parameterized Milkdrop-inspired presets, shuffled on each page load and auto-advanced every 14 seconds; the button displays the active preset position/name. v6.4.33 reshuffles the 80-preset Milkdrop deck on each activation and cross-blends feedback, waves, colour, blooms, and cadence with all 29 AI Warp profiles and all active FX voice levels. v6.4.34 adds a Drop the Milk opacity slider and lock control after the V-Sync slider; unlocked preset automation crossfades to preset opacity, while lock holds the chosen value. Opacity and lock preference persist across reloads. v6.4.35 reduces Milkdrop opacity targets, feedback alpha, waveform/bloom intensity and additive blending to prevent white-out; default opacity is 30%, preset opacity tops at 37%, legacy saved levels are capped at 38%, and feedback uses soft-light. v6.4.36 (web) replaces the Pole - R showcase with four original synthesized Raum X-R tracks hosted in ai_warp_engine/audio/, adds an artwork slideshow and exclusive audio-aware glitch sequences on the main canvas while they play, and credits Stefan Betke (Pole), GitHub Copilot and River Lyle Reuveni.
